# Pesher Habakkuk Column 1 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Pesher Habakkuk Column 1 where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 1:2 — "cry out" vs. "call for help"
| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "shall-I-cry-out" | Hyphenated literal form of Hebrew za'aq |
| LOGOS | "shall I cry out" | Standard formal rendering |
| PNEUMA | "must I call for help" | Dynamic rendering focusing on purpose |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS rendering "shall I cry out." Preserves the Hebrew verbal force without EMET's mechanical hyphenation; PNEUMA's paraphrase loses the raw emotional directness.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 1:3 — "contention arises" vs. "strife everywhere"
| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "there-is strife and-contention [arises...]" | Literal construct |
| LOGOS | "there is strife and contention arises" | Formal equivalent |
| PNEUMA | "there is conflict and strife everywhere" | Dynamic expansion |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted modified form "strife and contention arise." PNEUMA's "everywhere" adds content not in the Hebrew; EMET's hyphenation is unnecessary.

**Status:** Resolved; modified from all three.

---

## 1:10 — "understanding" vs. "wisdom" vs. "insight"
| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "understanding" | Literal for Hebrew binah |
| LOGOS | "understanding" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "insight" | Dynamic synonym |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "understanding" (EMET/LOGOS). "Insight" is acceptable but "understanding" is closer to binah.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 1:12 — "grows weak" vs. "grows feeble" vs. "is paralyzed"
| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "grows-weak" | Literal for Hebrew tapug |
| LOGOS | "grows feeble" | Slightly elevated register |
| PNEUMA | "is paralyzed" | Vivid dynamic rendering |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS rendering "grows feeble." More precise than "weak"; PNEUMA's "paralyzed" overstates the Hebrew.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---
*Total disagreements in Column 1: 4 | Covers Hab 1:1-5*
